Selection presets, side by side

Source: R/config.R
scr_presets.Rd

Returns the keys a preset changes, resolved, to compare before choosing. Every other configuration key is identical across presets.

Usage

scr_presets()

Value

A data.frame with one row per preset.

See also

Other configuration: scr_config(), scr_config_keys(), scr_verbose()

Examples

scr_presets()
#>       preset target_min target_max min_votes corr_cutoff iv_min iv_max
#> 1 aggressive         10         15         3         0.6   0.03      1
#> 2   moderate         10         25         2         0.7   0.02      1
#> 3       lazy         10         40         1         0.8   0.02      1
